get.description:
Returns day-by-day sales totals plus a roll-up list of organization totals, ordered by date ascending. Supplying only one of `start_date` / `end_date` applies no date filter — both are needed for the range to take effect.

Unlike the other summary endpoints this workbook is serialised as plain JSON, so the `name` and `@entity` markers are absent and the list block reports each metric as a `key` / `value` pair.

parameters.description: Start of the range. Applied only when `end_date` is also supplied.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: End of the range. Applied only when `start_date` is also supplied.

get.description: Streams a CSV with one row per redemption over the requested period, ordered by redemption date. The response is streamed and is not wrapped in the standard `{ code, message, data }` envelope.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start of the reporting period (inclusive). Required.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the reporting period (inclusive). Required.
